items.text: The wait is over! Today we’re rolling out a brand-new update for Recycling Center Simulator! 🚀 This update brings exciting new content, quality-of-life improvements and a few bug fixes! Below you’ll find the full samll patch notes with all the details 👇

This brand-new expansion will introduce a completely new production chain focused on e-waste recycling. Collect discarded electronics and use specialized machines to turn them into valuable products like solar panels, batteries and modern electronics.

releases.displayName: Brand new update for Recycling Center Simulator! ♻️

notes.title: New year new us, and do we have some exciting news for you! As we announced in one of our previous posts, our brand new QoL update just dropped, and what an update it is! Inventory sheet, so you can track your products in storage, new contract filters to make finding offers even easier, early loan payments so you can spend that cash overflow.

items.text: There is still more that this update has to offer. Bug fixes for the flashlight being pesky in minigames (somebody was clearly holding that flashlight wrong), the lockpicks should now behave consistently, and Send message button will no longer keep growing, because at some point it had to.
Check out what exactly we have in store for you this time, and remember to look over our Update Plan in our previous post, to see what’s ahead for Recycling Center Simulator.
v1.3. WHAT'S NEW? 🔥
• From now on, you can cancel your contracts with paying cancelation fee.
• Inventory sheet! From now on you can keep track of your products in your storage with inventory sheet! (Use Tab or R3 to open)
• New contract filters to find suitable offers more faster and easier!
• From now on, you can put sorted waste boxes to the pallets!
• Early payment option for loans.
BUG FIXES 🔧
• Fixed flashlight overexposure issues in lockpicking and crowbar minigames.
• Trucks' body colliders revised.
• Waste spawn areas in collection sites revised.
• Fixed an issue that causes lockpick to rotate strangely.
• Send message button in bargain panel gets bigger bug has fixed.
• Colliders in some areas revised.

notes.title: That’s not all! To celebrate the update, the game is now on sale! You can check all those changes out for yourself and play the new update over here right now!

items.text: Let us know what you think, and remember, we still have plenty of content in store for you.
Happy recycling,

releases.displayName: 🚨 New Update Alert for Recycling Center Simulator! 🚨

items.text: We’ve got some awesome news for all of you today! Our latest update has just dropped, and we’re finally bringing you something you’ve been asking for… Gamepad support! 🎮 Yes, that’s right! No more fiddling with a mouse and keyboard if you’re a controller enthusiast. Plug in your gamepad and dive right into the recycling madness!

But that’s not all! We’ve also squashed a few bugs 🐞 and made some improvements, including a reduction in newspaper and cardboard sizes (because let’s be real, who needs mountains of paper? 🌍). It’s all about making your recycling experience smoother and more fun!
But wait, there's more! 🚀
We’ve also got a sneak peek at our Update Plan for the upcoming months. Here's what you can expect:
📅 December — Gamepad Support (yep, it’s here!)
📅 January — QoL & Bug Fixes 🔧
📅 February — Major Update: Hybrid Production ⚡
📅 March — QoL & Bug Fixes (again, because we love making things smoother)
📅 April — Bio Gas DLC (get ready to turn waste into energy! ♻️)

notes.title: Here's a little sneak peek of February's update

items.text: So yeah, the recycling future looks bright, and we’re just getting started! Keep your eyes peeled for all the cool stuff coming soon. 🦾

We want to hear from you! Got any ideas or suggestions for future updates? Think we can make recycling even more awesome? Drop your thoughts in the comments or hit us up on social media! We love hearing from you, even if it's just a "hey, can you make a cardboard robot?" 🤖
Stay tuned and keep those gamepads charged, because we’ve got some exciting stuff coming your way. And remember, the only thing more satisfying than recycling is recycling in style. 😎
Happy recycling! ♻️

We just dropped a MAJOR UPDATE for Recycling Center Simulator, and our dev team poured countless hours into making this the best version yet! Whether you’re a longtime player or just getting started, now’s the perfect time to jump in, explore the new features, and experience how much the game has leveled up!
WHAT'S NEW? 🔥
A brand-new truck 🚛 – haul in even more waste with this expanded capacity!
Waste Radar 🛰️ – track down waste more easily and clean up faster.
Randomized Market Events 📉📈 – stay updated on market fluctuations and seize the best deals!
New areas to explore 🌍 – discover fresh loot at Train Stations and Museums!
Robot Control at Kiosks 🤖 – now you can use the “Undefined” option to stop robots from crowding specific areas.
Now you can see owned machine counts in machine store!
Cloud save system.
BUG FIXES 🔧
Sorting Workers with Leader Certificates no longer slow down.
The Crowbar mini-game UI now displays correctly on all screen resolutions.
No more scattered products; items stay in place!
Waste only spawns in accessible locations (we’re still fixing a few rare spots).
Pedestrians won’t randomly freeze in place.
Factory upgrades and Recycle Containers work perfectly in new games.
Colliders and interaction visibility have been improved.
Localization errors? Fixed! ✔️
Trash Collector is not being available at Reputation Level 5 issue fixed.
Fixed an issue that causes Scrap Deals menu not work which ends up breaking the game completely.
Fixed an issue that breaks the game when player's reputation level increased first time after successful sorting.
Non-working achievements fixed.
Ready to jump back in?
If you’re a regular, come see how these updates transform the gameplay – and if you’re new, it’s the perfect time to dive in and start recycling! 🌱
Happy recycling, and let us know what you think! 👀

We would like to start with a huge thank you for your warm welcome to the full version of Recycling Center Simulator! Your involvement, activity and feedback are invaluable to us - it is thanks to you that we are developing this project and making it better and better. Every comment, suggestion and problem report you make is taken into account, so we're rolling out an update soon that addresses many of these issues!

items.text: Hello Recyclers!

Capacity GUI changed. Carried to middle
I'm stuck button added to pause panel
Returning home blocked while in gathering tutorial

"Area completion percent going over %100" issue fixed.
"Objects left in truck's body counts as gathered object at new area" issue fixed.

Thank you for helping us shape the game. Please keep the feedback coming!
